description: Java implementation of the TimSort algorithm, ported from Android Open Source Project, used for stable, adaptive, iterative mergesort within Apache Spark's collection utilities.

classes.name: TimSort
classes.description: Main class implementing the TimSort algorithm with generic key and buffer types, including internal state management for sorting process.

classes.name: SortState
classes.description: Inner class managing the state of ongoing sort, including run stack, temporary storage, and merge operations.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs the TimSort on a specified array segment with a comparator.

methods.name: binarySort
methods.description: Performs binary insertion sort on a segment, optimized for small or nearly sorted data.

methods.name: countRunAndMakeAscending
methods.description: Counts the length of a run starting at a position, reversing if descending to ensure ascending order.

methods.name: reverseRange
methods.description: Reverses a range within the buffer.

methods.name: minRunLength
methods.description: Calculates the minimum run length for a given array size.

methods.name: mergeAt
methods.description: Merges two adjacent runs on the stack at a specified index.

methods.name: mergeCollapse
methods.description: Collapses runs on the stack to maintain invariants before final merge.

methods.name: mergeForceCollapse
methods.description: Merges all remaining runs to complete the sort.

methods.name: mergeLo
methods.description: Merges two runs where the first is smaller, in a stable manner.

methods.name: mergeHi
methods.description: Merges two runs where the second is smaller, in a stable manner.

methods.name: gallopLeft
methods.description: Finds insertion point for a key in a run, favoring the leftmost position for equal keys.

methods.name: gallopRight
methods.description: Finds insertion point for a key in a run, favoring the rightmost position for equal keys.

methods.name: ensureCapacity
methods.description: Ensures temporary buffer has enough capacity, expanding if necessary.
